text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'm sure Buena-san 
will be thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even so... it feels surprisingly nice to 
the touch. The expression is adorable too, 
and it fits right in the palm of your 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... We might end up facing each other 
in a rematch eventually.
